data.title: 雨夜古堡露台的隐秘换碟
data.location: 复古晚宴大厅外侧的石柱雨廊
data.lighting: 宴会厅暖金门光与露台冷雨蓝光
data.prompt: adult, 1girl, solo, ayachi_nene, nene_r18, smoky purple strapless satin evening gown, high side slit, silver choker necklace, long satin opera gloves, black garter strap on thigh, leaning against marble pillar, lifting dress slit slightly, slipping micro memory chip from thigh strap, glancing sideways at viewer, composed slight blush, stone balcony, rain outside, warm ballroom chandelier light from left, cool blue rainlight from right, pillar foreground, cowboy shot
data.animaCaption: Leaning against a marble colonnade between the glowing ballroom and the rainy balcony, she lifts the high slit of her smoky purple satin gown to slide a micro-chip from her thigh garter toward you. Warm chandelier gold and cool blue rainlight split cleanly across her bare shoulder and satin gloves.
data.promptProse: Framed past the fluted edge of a wet marble pillar in the foreground, Ayachi Nene pauses in the shadowed veranda outside a glowing masquerade hall. She wears a sleek smoky-purple strapless satin evening gown with a daring side slit, a delicate silver choker, and elbow-length satin gloves; casually lifting the hem along her hip, she draws a tiny metallic data chip from a concealed black thigh strap and passes it discreetly toward the viewer with a poised, sidelong glance. Warm amber chandelier light spills from the tall glass doors on the left while cold blue rain streaks the night air on the right.
data.story: 宴会厅的弦乐被半掩的落地门隔在身后。换上烟紫露肩长裙的宁宁借着大理石柱遮挡视线，镇定地掀起高开叉裙摆，从大腿暗带里抽出一枚冰凉的加密晶片贴进你掌心——「东西到手了。别盯太久……再跳完最后一支舞我们就撤。」
